document_title: Error Recovery and What Happens When Things Go Wrong
description: Every error scenario you might encounter and how the program handles it
overall_philosophy: The program tries to fix problems automatically whenever possible. You only get asked to make decisions when there are multiple options or when the problem can't be fixed automatically.

edge_tts_connection_timeout.what_went_wrong: The Microsoft TTS server didn't respond in time
edge_tts_connection_timeout.if_you_say_no: Chapter is skipped and marked as failed

edge_tts_rate_limited.what_went_wrong: You sent too many requests to Microsoft's servers, they temporarily blocked you

piper_model_not_found.what_went_wrong: The voice model file you selected doesn't exist
piper_model_not_found.you_are_asked: 'Select a different model or switch to pyttsx3? (1-3)'

piper_crash.what_went_wrong: The Piper program crashed while generating audio
piper_crash.if_keeps_crashing: '⚠️ Piper keeps crashing. This chapter has very long text. Breaking into smaller chunks...'

chatterbox_out_of_memory.what_went_wrong: Your GPU doesn't have enough memory for Chatterbox
chatterbox_out_of_memory.automatic_recovery: '🔄 Switching to Piper for remaining chapters...'

all_tts_engines_failed.what_went_wrong: Every voice engine failed for this chapter
what_you_see: '❌ CRITICAL: All TTS engines failed for Chapter 5'

ffmpeg_not_installed.what_went_wrong: FFmpeg is not installed on your computer
ffmpeg_not_installed.what_you_see: '❌ FFmpeg not found. Video creation is not possible.'
ffmpeg_not_installed.if_choose_audio_only: Program generates the audiobook MP3 file but skips video creation

ffmpeg_encoding_failed.what_went_wrong: FFmpeg crashed while creating the video
ffmpeg_encoding_failed.what_changes: GPU acceleration is disabled, effects are removed, basic encoding is used

if_still_fails.what_you_see: '❌ Video creation failed even with simple settings.'

whisper_not_available.what_went_wrong: The Whisper transcription tool isn't installed
whisper_not_available.what_you_see: '⚠️ faster-whisper not installed. Subtitles will be chapter-based only.'

what_this_means.without_whisper: Subtitles show chapter titles at the start of each chapter
what_this_means.with_whisper: Subtitles show every word as it's spoken (word-by-word captions)

disk_full.what_went_wrong: Your hard drive ran out of space during rendering
disk_full.what_you_see: '❌ Disk full: Cannot write video file'
disk_full.automatic_action: '🧹 Attempting to free space by cleaning temp files...'
disk_full.if_still_full: '❌ Not enough disk space. Need at least 2 GB free. Please free up space and try again.'

subtitle_file_error.automatic_fix: The program fixes overlapping times and invalid entries

epub_file_unreadable.what_went_wrong: The EPUB file is corrupted or has an unsupported format
epub_file_unreadable.what_you_see: '❌ Cannot read EPUB file. The file may be corrupted or password-protected.'
suggestions: Try opening the EPUB in an e-reader app to verify it works

output_folder_locked.what_went_wrong: Another program is using the output folder
output_folder_locked.what_you_see: '❌ Permission denied: Cannot write to output folder'
output_folder_locked.automatic_retry: '🔄 Waiting 5 seconds for file to be released...'
output_folder_locked.if_still_locked: '❌ File still locked. Close any programs using files in this folder.'

cannot_extract_cover.what_went_wrong: The EPUB doesn't have a cover image
cannot_extract_cover.what_you_see: '⚠️ No cover image found in EPUB'

complete_offline.when_detected: At startup if Edge-TTS is configured
complete_offline.what_you_see: '⚠️ No internet connection detected. Edge-TTS will not work.'
complete_offline.automatic_switch: '✅ Switching to Piper (offline) as default engine.'

internet_drops_during_processing.what_happens: You lose internet while using Edge-TTS
internet_drops_during_processing.automatic_recovery: Retries, then offers to switch to Piper
internet_drops_during_processing.completed_chapters_kept: Everything processed so far is saved

if_program_crashes.what_happens: Power outage, computer crash, or program error
if_program_crashes.if_you_resume: Processing continues from chapter 8, using all previously completed work
if_program_crashes.if_you_dont_resume: Starts completely fresh (previous work is discarded)

pattern_learning.what_this_means: The program remembers what errors you've encountered before

example_frequent_edge_tts_failures.after_5_edge_tts_failures: '💡 Suggestion: Edge-TTS has failed frequently. Consider switching to Piper as your default engine.'
example_frequent_edge_tts_failures.you_can_accept_or_ignore: This is just a suggestion, not forced

cascading_failure_detection.what_it_is: When 3 or more failures happen in a row
cascading_failure_detection.what_you_see: '⚠️ Multiple consecutive failures detected. Pausing to avoid wasting resources.'
options: 1. Try a completely different TTS engine

manual_recovery_option.always_available: At any error prompt, you can usually type 'skip' or 'cancel'
manual_recovery_option.skip: Skips the current chapter and continues with the next
manual_recovery_option.cancel: Stops processing entirely but keeps completed work
